transparent-theme.name: Transparent Theme Fix
transparent-theme.description: Corrige los popups blancos manteniendo la transparencia
transparent-theme.css: /* Forzar fondo sólido en menús flotantes, popups y paneles de extensiones */ #customization-panel, .panel-arrowcontent, panelmultiview, menupopup, .thunderbird-popup, #appMenu-popup, #customization-panel-container { background-color: #1e1e1e !important; background-image: none !important; border: 1px solid #333333 !important; } .panel-arrowcontent *, menupopup * { color: #ffffff !important; }
